nodes.description: Address stored as contract owner; set to msg.sender in Owned constructor and compared in the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string set to '$MUSK' in the constructor.
Public token name string set to 'Papa Elon Musk' in the constructor.
Public token decimals set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply (29061971000000000000000000) minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; written by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf/totalSupply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance table written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
Pure addition helper with an overflow require; used by transfer/transferFrom to credit balances.
Pure subtraction helper with an underflow require; used to debit token balances and allowances.
Pure multiplication helper with an overflow require; not called elsewhere in this contract.
Pure division helper with a divide-by-zero require; not called elsewhere in this contract.
Constructor that initialises owner to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function staging a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership handover by requiring msg.sender == newOwner and promoting newOwner to owner.
Initialises symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Constant getter returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer debiting msg.sender via safeSub and crediting 'to' via safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any double-spend protection.
Spends an allowance: debits 'from', decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits 'to'.
Constant getter returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender and immediately invokes an external callback receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an external ERC20Interface transfer of a foreign token.
Caller address checked by onlyOwner and acceptOwnership; attacker-controllable.
Implicit token-owner argument of transfer; attacker-controllable.
Implicit owner index of the allowance mapping in approve; attacker-controllable.
Implicit spender index of transferFrom used to consume the allowance; attacker-controllable.
Implicit owner index of the allowance mapping and the 'from' argument forwarded to the external callback.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state writes; enables reentrancy on the approval/transfer flow.
External call to an arbitrary tokenAddress via ERC20Interface.transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token.
Raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed without SafeMath inside totalSupply.
